description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of ethical principles discussed within the MedEthicsQA dataset. The chart contains 16 slices, each representing a different ethical principle. The slices are labeled as follows: “Justice” (dark blue), “Beneficence” (light blue), “Autonomy” (green), “Non-Maleficence” (orange), “Promote the Health of Environment and Public Education” (yellow), “Recognize the Responsibility of the Occupation” (light green), “Comply with Laws and Regulations” (dark green), “Provide Medical Care to Patients” (teal), “Prevent Patient from Providing Unethical and Improper Conduct” (purple), “Maintain Qualified Medical Staff” (violet), “Report Unreasonable for Personal Gain” (pink), “Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve” (red), “Make Responsible and Independent Clinical Judgement” (brown), “Professional Relationship with Patients and Their Relatives” (gray), “Keep Confidentiality of Patient’s Information” (light gray), and “Respect Patient’s Rights to be Informed, Freedom of Choice” (beige). The chart includes percentage labels within each slice, ranging from approximately 1% to 16%. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion. A legend is included to correlate the colors with the ethical principles.
